column5: IdentityLookupRequest/IdentityLookupResult preserve the MatchIdentity username, remote-host, skip-name-resolve, canonical-row, and not-found contract; wildcard matching, privilege-table access, authentication verification, and authenticated-session publication remain external.

IdentityCatalog ports matchIdentity's sorted most-specific host selection, percent/underscore/escaped-byte patterns, localhost loopback and IPv4 network host matches, and caller-injected reverse-DNS fallback; privilege cache loading, actual DNS, SkipWithGrant, and authentication remain external.
